review:
Samurai on a grid where single wilds on reels 2 to 5 can slice into two or three. Bonus symbols landing with stacked samurai trigger Oni Transform, turning them into the best-paying symbol on screen.

Three bonus symbols give eight Shogun Spins – but if the Wild Geisha lands at the same time, you get eight Geisha Spins instead, where every nudge adds a sticky multiplier. High volatility, 30,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
